title: Refusal record
description: A refused input, recorded whole in the host's refusal log (REQ-AUD-1: refusals are recorded; guarantee exactly-once). That the record it points to holds the same record id is checked over a whole snapshot stream by the Rust types, since JSON Schema can't compare values.

seq.description: Its place in the host's refusal log, from 1, with no gap.

reason.description: record_id_reused: the record id is already recorded with other content.

existing.description: The record that already holds the input's record id.
